_meta.description: Self-acupressure points, diet entries and lifestyle guidance (draft; awaits TCM clinical and pharmacy review). Point locations and diet texts are bilingual; a food that is also a herb takes its nature, flavours and functions from the herb record.

三陰交.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

cautions.en: Do not press this point if you are pregnant or may be pregnant.
cautions.zh-Hant: 懷孕或可能懷孕時不要按壓此穴。

location.en: On the inner side of the lower leg, about four finger-widths above the inner ankle bone, just behind the edge of the shin bone.
location.zh-Hant: 小腿內側，內踝尖上約四橫指（3 寸），脛骨內側緣後方。

中脘.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

cautions.en: Do not press hard within half an hour after a meal, or where the abdomen is sore or has a surgical wound.
cautions.zh-Hant: 飯後半小時內及腹部有手術傷口或疼痛時不要重按。

location.en: On the midline of the upper abdomen, halfway between the lower end of the breastbone and the navel (about four finger-widths above the navel).
location.zh-Hant: 上腹部正中線上，胸骨下端與肚臍連線的中點（約肚臍上四橫指）。

內關.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

cautions.en: Do not press if the wrist or forearm is injured.
cautions.zh-Hant: 手腕或前臂有傷時不要按。

location.en: On the inner forearm, about two finger-widths above the wrist crease, between the two tendons in the middle.
location.zh-Hant: 前臂內側，手腕橫紋上約兩橫指（2 寸），兩條肌腱（掌長肌腱與橈側腕屈肌腱）之間。

列缺.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

location.en: On the thumb side of the forearm, about two finger-widths above the wrist crease, in the groove at the edge of the bone.
location.zh-Hant: 前臂外側（拇指側），手腕橫紋上約兩橫指（1.5 寸），橈骨（前臂拇指側的骨頭）邊緣的凹溝中。

合谷.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

cautions.en: Press with light to moderate force, never hard.
cautions.zh-Hant: 按壓力道宜輕到中等，不可重壓。

cautions.en: Do not press this point if you are pregnant or may be pregnant.
cautions.zh-Hant: 懷孕或可能懷孕時不要按壓此穴。

location.en: On the back of the hand, between the thumb and index finger bones, at the middle of the index finger's long bone on the thumb side; the highest point of the muscle when the thumb is pressed against the index finger.
location.zh-Hant: 手背，第一、二掌骨之間，約在第二掌骨（食指延伸到手背的骨頭）靠拇指側的中點；拇指與食指併攏時，肌肉隆起的最高點。

命門.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

location.en: On the midline of the lower back, at the level of the navel, in the hollow below the spine bump there.
location.zh-Hant: 腰部正中線上，與肚臍同高（第二腰椎棘突下方）的凹陷中。

大椎.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

cautions.en: Rub lightly only; do not press hard with a fever or a sore neck.
cautions.zh-Hant: 輕揉即可；有發燒或頸部不適時不要重壓。

location.en: On the midline at the base of the neck, in the hollow just below the most prominent bone bump when the head is bent forward.
location.zh-Hant: 後頸部正中線上，最突出的頸椎（第七頸椎）棘突下方的凹陷中，低頭時最明顯的骨突下緣。

太淵.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

location.en: On the inner wrist crease on the thumb side, where the pulse can be felt.
location.zh-Hant: 手腕掌側橫紋上，靠拇指側，可摸到脈搏跳動處。

太溪.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

location.en: On the inner ankle, in the hollow halfway between the inner ankle bone and the Achilles tendon.
location.zh-Hant: 腳踝內側，內踝尖與腳後跟的大筋（跟腱）之間的凹陷中。

太衝.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

location.en: On top of the foot, in the hollow between the long bones of the big toe and the second toe, about two finger-widths up from the web between them.
location.zh-Hant: 腳背，第一、二蹠骨（大腳趾與第二趾延伸到腳背的骨頭）之間，由趾縫往腳踝方向推到骨頭交會前的凹陷處，約兩橫指。

崑崙.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

cautions.en: Do not press this point if you are pregnant or may be pregnant.
cautions.zh-Hant: 懷孕或可能懷孕時不要按壓此穴。

location.en: On the outer ankle, in the hollow halfway between the outer ankle bone and the Achilles tendon.
location.zh-Hant: 腳踝外側，外踝尖與腳後跟的大筋（跟腱）之間的凹陷中。

曲池.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

location.en: On the outer elbow, with the elbow bent at a right angle, halfway between the outer end of the elbow crease and the bony bump on the outside of the elbow.
location.zh-Hant: 手肘外側，屈肘 90 度時，肘橫紋外側端與肱骨外側突起（外上髁）連線的中點。

次髎.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

cautions.en: Do not press this point if you are pregnant or may be pregnant.
cautions.zh-Hant: 懷孕或可能懷孕時不要按壓此穴。

location.en: On the sacrum (the flat triangular bone at the base of the spine), one on each side, in the second small hollow from the top; it is hard to find by yourself, so ask a practitioner to show you.
location.zh-Hant: 骶骨（脊椎下端的三角形平骨）上，左右各一，位於第二個骶後孔的凹陷中；位置不易自找，宜請專業人員示範。

氣海.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

cautions.en: Press gently on the lower abdomen.
cautions.zh-Hant: 下腹部按壓宜輕。

location.en: On the midline of the lower abdomen, about two finger-widths below the navel.
location.zh-Hant: 下腹部正中線上，肚臍下約兩橫指（1.5 寸）。

湧泉.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

cautions.en: Do not press hard if the sole is wounded or has reduced feeling (for example in diabetes).
cautions.zh-Hant: 腳底有傷口、感覺遲鈍（例如糖尿病）時不要用力按。

location.en: On the sole, in the hollow that forms when the toes curl, about a third of the way from the toes to the heel.
location.zh-Hant: 腳底，捲起腳趾時足心最凹陷處，約在腳掌前三分之一與後三分之二交界。

百會.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

cautions.en: Do not press if the scalp is wounded or inflamed.
cautions.zh-Hant: 頭皮有傷口或發炎時不要按。

location.en: On top of the head, on the midline, where a line joining the tips of the two ears crosses it.
location.zh-Hant: 頭頂正中線上，兩耳尖連線與頭頂正中線的交會處。

石門.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

cautions.en: Do not press this point if you are pregnant or may be pregnant.
cautions.zh-Hant: 懷孕或可能懷孕時不要按壓此穴。

location.en: On the midline of the lower abdomen, about three finger-widths below the navel.
location.zh-Hant: 下腹部正中線上，肚臍下約三橫指（2 寸）。

神門.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

location.en: On the inner wrist crease on the little-finger side, in the hollow beside the tendon.
location.zh-Hant: 手腕掌側橫紋上，靠小指側，肌腱（尺側腕屈肌腱）外緣的凹陷中。

肩井.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

cautions.en: Do not press this point if you are pregnant or may be pregnant.
cautions.zh-Hant: 懷孕或可能懷孕時不要按壓此穴。

location.en: On top of the shoulder, halfway between the bone bump at the base of the neck and the tip of the shoulder.
location.zh-Hant: 肩膀上方，頸後最突出的骨突（大椎）與肩膀外緣（肩峰）連線的中點。

腎俞.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

location.en: On the lower back at the level of the navel, about two finger-widths to each side of the spine.
location.zh-Hant: 腰部，與肚臍同高的脊椎棘突（第二腰椎）下方，脊椎左右各旁開約兩橫指。

膈俞.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

location.en: On the upper back at the level of the lower tip of the shoulder blade, about two finger-widths to each side of the spine.
location.zh-Hant: 背部，與肩胛骨下角同高的脊椎棘突（第七胸椎）下方，脊椎左右各旁開約兩橫指。

膻中.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

cautions.en: Press the breastbone only gently; if you have chest pain or tightness, do not press it yourself — follow the advice to see a doctor.
cautions.zh-Hant: 胸骨處以輕柔按揉為主；若有胸痛、胸悶，不要自行按壓，請依畫面提示就醫。

location.en: On the midline of the chest, halfway between the nipples.
location.zh-Hant: 胸部正中線上，兩乳頭連線的中點（平第四肋間）。

至陰.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

cautions.en: Do not press this point if you are pregnant or may be pregnant.
cautions.zh-Hant: 懷孕或可能懷孕時不要按壓此穴。

location.en: On the outer side of the little toe, right beside the outer corner of the toenail.
location.zh-Hant: 腳小趾外側，趾甲外側角旁約 0.1 寸（一小段指甲寬）。

血海.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

cautions.en: Do not press this point if you are pregnant or may be pregnant.
cautions.zh-Hant: 懷孕或可能懷孕時不要按壓此穴。

location.en: On the inner thigh, with the knee bent, about two finger-widths above the inner upper corner of the kneecap, on the muscle bulge.
location.zh-Hant: 大腿內側，屈膝時，髕骨（膝蓋骨）內側上緣往上約兩橫指的肌肉隆起處。

行間.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

location.en: On top of the foot, in the web between the big toe and the second toe, just behind the edge of the web.
location.zh-Hant: 腳背，大腳趾與第二趾之間的趾蹼邊緣後方，皮膚顏色交界處。

豐隆.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

location.en: On the outer side of the lower leg, halfway between the outer ankle bone and the outer end of the crease behind the knee, about two finger-widths outside the shin bone.
location.zh-Hant: 小腿外側，外踝尖與膝蓋後方橫紋外側端連線的中點，脛骨外緣再向外約兩橫指處。

足三里.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

location.en: On the outer side of the lower leg, about four finger-widths below the outer hollow under the kneecap and one finger-width outside the shin bone.
location.zh-Hant: 小腿外側，膝蓋外側凹陷（外膝眼）往下約四橫指（3 寸），脛骨（小腿前面的骨頭）外緣再向外約一橫指處。

關元.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

cautions.en: Press gently on the lower abdomen, and not during heavy menstrual bleeding.
cautions.zh-Hant: 下腹部按壓宜輕；月經量多時不要按。

cautions.en: Do not press this point if you are pregnant or may be pregnant.
cautions.zh-Hant: 懷孕或可能懷孕時不要按壓此穴。

location.en: On the midline of the lower abdomen, about four finger-widths below the navel.
location.zh-Hant: 下腹部正中線上，肚臍下約四橫指（3 寸）。

陰陵泉.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

location.en: On the inner side of the lower leg, in the hollow just below the bony bulge at the top of the inner edge of the shin bone, below the knee.
location.zh-Hant: 小腿內側，脛骨內側緣向上推至膝下，骨頭轉彎突起處下方的凹陷中。

風池.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

cautions.en: Press the neck gently; never pound or force it.
cautions.zh-Hant: 頸部按壓宜輕柔，不可用力捶打或扳動頸部。

location.en: At the back of the neck below the base of the skull, in the hollow on the outer side of the two large cords in the middle of the neck.
location.zh-Hant: 後頸部，枕骨（後腦勺下緣）之下，頸後兩條大筋外側的凹陷中。

魚際.basis: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008), in the project's own words

location.en: On the thumb side of the palm, at the middle of the thumb's long bone, on the border between the palm and the back of the hand.
location.zh-Hant: 手掌拇指根部隆起（大魚際）的外緣，第一掌骨中點，掌面與手背交界處。

cautions.en: Do not press on skin that is broken, inflamed, bruised or swollen.
cautions.zh-Hant: 皮膚破損、發炎、瘀青或腫脹處不要按壓。

cautions.en: Stop at once if pain gets worse or you feel dizzy, sick, cold-sweaty or numb.
cautions.zh-Hant: 按壓時若出現疼痛加劇、頭暈、噁心、冒冷汗或麻木，請立即停止。

cautions.en: Acupressure does not replace seeing a doctor; if the discomfort continues or gets worse, please see one.
cautions.zh-Hant: 穴位按壓不能取代就醫；不適持續或加重時請就診。

how.en: Press and knead with the thumb or a fingertip using light to moderate pressure, about 1 to 3 minutes per point, until you feel a dull ache but not pain; once or twice a day. Most points are paired, so you can press both sides.
how.zh-Hant: 用拇指或指腹以輕到中等的力道按揉，每個穴位約 1 至 3 分鐘，以有痠脹感但不疼痛為度；每天 1 至 2 次。穴位位置以左右兩側對稱為主，可雙側都按。

cautions.en: Use little with yin deficiency and internal heat.
cautions.zh-Hant: 陰虛內熱者少用。

rationale.en: Pungent, bitter and warm; traditionally used to soothe the liver and regulate qi, to harmonise the stomach and ease pain, and to dry dampness and resolve phlegm.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味辛、苦、性溫；傳統功效：疏肝理氣、和胃止痛、燥濕化痰。

cautions.en: Use little if the spleen and stomach are weak and cold, or with loose stools.
cautions.zh-Hant: 脾胃虛寒、腹瀉者少用。

rationale.en: Sweet, bland and slightly cold; traditionally used to promote urination and reduce swelling and to clear summer heat; usually made into soup.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘淡、性微寒，傳統上用於利水消腫、清熱解暑；常煮湯食用。

rationale.en: Sweet and warm; traditionally used to tonify the middle and qi and support the spleen and stomach; usually steamed or boiled.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、性溫，傳統上用於補中益氣、健脾養胃；常蒸煮食用。

rationale.en: Sweet, salty and cool; traditionally used to nourish the stomach and harmonise the middle; a common porridge grain when the digestion is weak.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘鹹、性涼，傳統上用於養胃、和中；常作病後或脾胃虛弱時的粥食。

rationale.en: Sweet and cool; traditionally used to nourish the heart and ease restlessness, and to support the kidney.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、性涼；傳統功效：養心除煩、益腎。

cautions.en: Not suited to marked internal heat or yin deficiency with fire; use with caution in pregnancy.
cautions.zh-Hant: 內熱明顯或陰虛火旺者不宜；孕婦慎用。

rationale.en: A small amount of cinnamon bark: pungent, sweet and very hot; traditionally used to warm the yang and disperse cold, and to free the channels.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味辛、甘、性大熱；傳統功效：補火助陽、引火歸元、散寒止痛、溫通經脈。

cautions.en: Use with caution in pregnancy; use little with excess stomach acid or a stomach ulcer.
cautions.zh-Hant: 孕婦慎用；胃酸過多、胃潰瘍者少用。

rationale.en: Sour, sweet and slightly warm; traditionally used to aid digestion of meat and fat, and to move qi and disperse stasis.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味酸、甘、性微溫；傳統功效：消食健胃、行氣散瘀、化濁降脂。

rationale.en: Sweet and neutral; traditionally used to support the spleen and stomach, nourish body fluids and the lung, and support the kidney.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、性平；傳統功效：補脾養胃、生津益肺、補腎澀精。

cautions.en: Use little with a weak spleen, dampness or loose stools.
cautions.zh-Hant: 脾虛濕盛、腹瀉者少用。

rationale.en: Wolfberry: sweet and neutral; traditionally used to nourish the liver and kidney and to benefit the essence and the eyes.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、性平；傳統功效：滋補肝腎、益精明目。

cautions.en: Use little with poor digestion or a bloated belly.
cautions.zh-Hant: 消化不良、腹脹者少用。

rationale.en: Sweet and warm; traditionally used to nourish the stomach, support the spleen and strengthen the kidney and sinews; hard to digest, so eat a little.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、性溫，傳統上用於養胃健脾、補腎強筋；不易消化，宜少量。

cautions.en: Use little with loose stools or phlegm-heat.
cautions.zh-Hant: 大便溏瀉、痰熱者少用。

rationale.en: Walnut kernel: sweet and warm; traditionally used to support the kidney and warm the lung, and to moisten the bowels.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、性溫；傳統功效：補腎、溫肺、潤腸。

cautions.en: Use little with phlegm-fire or damp stagnation; ask first in pregnancy.
cautions.zh-Hant: 內有痰火、濕滯者少用；孕婦宜先諮詢。

rationale.en: Longan flesh: sweet and warm; traditionally used to tonify the heart and spleen, nourish blood and calm the spirit.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、性溫；傳統功效：補益心脾、養血安神。

cautions.en: Use little if the spleen and stomach are weak and cold, or with loose stools.
cautions.zh-Hant: 脾胃虛寒、腹瀉者少用。

rationale.en: Mulberry: sweet, sour and cold; traditionally used to nourish yin and blood, and to generate fluids and moisten dryness.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、酸、性寒；傳統功效：滋陰補血、生津潤燥。

cautions.en: If the spleen and stomach are weak and cold, or with loose stools, cook it and eat only a little.
cautions.zh-Hant: 脾胃虛寒、腹瀉者宜煮熟並少量。

rationale.en: Sweet, slightly sour and cool; traditionally used to clear heat, generate fluids, moisten dryness and resolve phlegm; eaten raw or stewed.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘微酸、性涼，傳統上用於清熱生津、潤燥化痰；可生食或燉煮。

rationale.en: Warm porridge; traditionally used to nourish the stomach qi and warm the middle; soft and easy to digest.
rationale.zh-Hant: 溫熱的粥，傳統上用於養胃氣、暖中；質地軟、易消化。

rationale.en: Thin hot rice porridge; traditionally used to nourish the stomach qi and support a formula's action — the classical instructions for Guizhi Tang say to sip hot thin porridge after it.
rationale.zh-Hant: 熱的稀粥，傳統上用於養胃氣、助藥力；《傷寒論》桂枝湯方後即有「啜熱稀粥」的服法。

cautions.en: Use little with yin deficiency and fire.
cautions.zh-Hant: 陰虛火旺者少用。

rationale.en: Sweet, bitter and warm; traditionally used to move qi and relieve constraint, to harmonise the blood and ease pain.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、苦、性溫；傳統功效：行氣解鬱、和血、止痛。

cautions.en: Use little with yin deficiency and fire.
cautions.zh-Hant: 陰虛火旺者少用。

rationale.en: Rose tea: sweet, bitter and warm; traditionally used to move qi and relieve constraint, to harmonise the blood and ease pain.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、苦、性溫；傳統功效：行氣解鬱、和血、止痛。

cautions.en: Use little if there is marked internal heat, a dry or sore throat, or yin deficiency.
cautions.zh-Hant: 內熱明顯、口乾咽痛或陰虛者少用。

rationale.en: Pungent and warm; traditionally used to release the exterior and disperse cold, warm the middle and ease nausea, and resolve phlegm.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味辛、性溫；傳統功效：解表散寒、溫中止嘔、化痰止咳。

cautions.en: Use little if the spleen and stomach are weak and cold, or with loose stools.
cautions.zh-Hant: 脾胃虛寒、腹瀉者少用。

rationale.en: Sweet and slightly cold; traditionally used to nourish yin and moisten the lung, and to clear the heart and calm the spirit.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、性微寒；傳統功效：養陰潤肺、清心安神。

cautions.en: Use little if the spleen and stomach are weak and cold, or with loose stools.
cautions.zh-Hant: 脾胃虛寒、腹瀉者少用。

rationale.en: Bamboo-shaving tea: sweet and slightly cold; traditionally used to clear heat and resolve phlegm, ease restlessness and nausea.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、性微寒；傳統功效：清熱化痰、除煩止嘔。

cautions.en: Use little with damp fullness or phlegm-heat; people watching their blood sugar should mind the amount.
cautions.zh-Hant: 濕盛脹滿、痰熱者少用；血糖偏高者留意用量。

rationale.en: Sweet and warm; traditionally used to tonify the middle and qi, and to nourish blood and calm the spirit.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、性溫；傳統功效：補中益氣、養血安神。

cautions.en: Use little with insomnia, palpitations or excess stomach acid; ask a doctor or pharmacist if you take medicines.
cautions.zh-Hant: 失眠、心悸、胃酸過多者少用；與藥物併用請先詢問。

rationale.en: Bitter, sweet and cool; traditionally used to clear heat, refresh the mind and promote urination; it contains caffeine, so do not overdo it or drink it before bed.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味苦甘、性涼，傳統上用於清熱、提神、利尿；含咖啡因，不宜過量或睡前飲用。

cautions.en: Not suited in quantity to a weak, cold spleen and stomach, or with loose stools.
cautions.zh-Hant: 脾胃虛寒、腹瀉者不宜多食。

rationale.en: Sweet and cold; traditionally used to clear heat and toxin, relieve summer heat and promote urination.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、性寒；傳統功效：清熱解毒、消暑、利水。

cautions.en: Not suited to marked internal heat, dry mouth with constipation, or high blood fats.
cautions.zh-Hant: 內熱明顯、口乾便秘、高血脂者少用。

rationale.en: Sweet and warm (leaning hot); traditionally eaten in winter to warm the middle and the lower body and to tonify qi and deficiency; not suited to marked internal heat.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、性溫（偏熱），傳統上於冬季用於溫中暖下、益氣補虛；內熱明顯者不宜。

cautions.en: Use little if the spleen and stomach are weak and cold, or with loose stools.
cautions.zh-Hant: 脾胃虛寒、腹瀉者少用。

rationale.en: Bitter and cold; traditionally used to clear heat and relieve summer heat and to brighten the eyes; stir-fried or made into soup.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味苦、性寒，傳統上用於清熱解暑、明目；常炒食或煮湯。

rationale.en: Sweet, bland and neutral; traditionally used to drain dampness, support the spleen and calm the heart.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、淡、性平；傳統功效：利水滲濕、健脾、寧心。

cautions.en: Use little if the spleen and stomach are weak and cold, or with loose stools.
cautions.zh-Hant: 脾胃虛寒、腹瀉者少用。

rationale.en: Sweet, bitter and slightly cold; traditionally used to disperse wind-heat, calm the liver and clear the eyes.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、苦、性微寒；傳統功效：疏散風熱、平抑肝陽、清肝明目、清熱解毒。

cautions.en: Use little if the spleen and stomach are weak and cold, or with loose stools.
cautions.zh-Hant: 脾胃虛寒、腹瀉者少用。

rationale.en: Chrysanthemum tea: sweet, bitter and slightly cold; traditionally used to disperse wind-heat, calm the liver and clear the eyes.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、苦、性微寒；傳統功效：疏散風熱、平抑肝陽、清肝明目、清熱解毒。

cautions.en: Not suited to people with hard, dry stools.
cautions.zh-Hant: 大便乾結者不宜多食。

rationale.en: Sweet, astringent and neutral; traditionally used to support the spleen, steady loose stools, support the kidney and calm the heart.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、澀、性平；傳統功效：補脾止瀉、止帶、益腎澀精、養心安神。

cautions.en: Not suited to people who already sweat a lot.
cautions.zh-Hant: 多汗、表虛者不宜。

rationale.en: Pungent and warm; traditionally used to induce sweating and release the exterior, and to disperse cold and free the yang.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味辛、性溫；傳統功效：發汗解表、散寒通陽。

cautions.en: Use little if you are weak and sweat easily.
cautions.zh-Hant: 體虛多汗者少用。

rationale.en: Pungent and cool; traditionally used to disperse wind-heat, clear the head and eyes and soothe the throat.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味辛、性涼；傳統功效：疏散風熱、清利頭目、利咽、透疹、疏肝行氣。

cautions.en: Use with caution in pregnancy; use little if fluids are low or you are constipated.
cautions.zh-Hant: 孕婦慎用；津液不足、便秘者少用。

rationale.en: Sweet, bland and cool; traditionally used to drain dampness and support the spleen, to steady loose stools and to ease stiffness of the joints.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、淡、性涼；傳統功效：利水滲濕、健脾止瀉、除痺、排膿、解毒散結。

cautions.en: Not suited to a weak, cold spleen and stomach.
cautions.zh-Hant: 脾胃虛寒者不宜。

rationale.en: Sweet and cold; traditionally used to clear heat, generate fluids, ease restlessness and nausea.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、性寒；傳統功效：清熱瀉火、生津止渴、除煩、止嘔、利尿。

cautions.en: People watching their blood sugar should mind the amount; never give honey to a baby under one year.
cautions.zh-Hant: 糖尿病或血糖偏高者留意用量；一歲以下嬰兒不可食用。

rationale.en: Sweet and neutral; traditionally used to tonify the middle, moisten dryness and ease pain.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、性平；傳統功效：補中、潤燥、止痛、解毒。

cautions.en: Use little if fluids are low or you pass a lot of urine.
cautions.zh-Hant: 津液不足、尿多者少用。

rationale.en: Sweet, sour and neutral; traditionally used to promote urination and reduce swelling, and to clear toxin.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、酸、性平；傳統功效：利水消腫、解毒排膿。

cautions.en: If you take sedatives or sleeping medicines, ask a doctor or pharmacist first.
cautions.zh-Hant: 與鎮靜安眠藥併用請先詢問醫師或藥師。

rationale.en: Jujube-seed tea: sweet, sour and neutral; traditionally used to nourish the heart and liver, calm the spirit and restrain sweating.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、酸、性平；傳統功效：養心補肝、寧心安神、斂汗、生津。

rationale.en: Sweet, bland and neutral; traditionally used to nourish yin and moisten the lung and to nourish the stomach and generate fluids; usually simmered.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘淡、性平，傳統上用於滋陰潤肺、養胃生津；常燉煮食用。

cautions.en: Use little with a red, dry tongue or marked internal heat.
cautions.zh-Hant: 舌紅少津、內熱明顯者少用。

rationale.en: Bitter, pungent and warm; traditionally used to regulate qi and support the spleen, to dry dampness and resolve phlegm.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味苦、辛、性溫；傳統功效：理氣健脾、燥濕化痰。

cautions.en: Use little during a cold with fever or with marked internal heat.
cautions.zh-Hant: 感冒發熱、內熱明顯時少用。

rationale.en: Sweet and warm; traditionally used to warm the middle, tonify qi and fill the essence; not suited during a cold with fever or with marked internal heat.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、性溫，傳統上用於溫中益氣、補精填髓；感冒發熱或內熱明顯時不宜。

cautions.en: Use little with yin deficiency and internal heat, or with sores.
cautions.zh-Hant: 陰虛內熱、瘡瘍者少用。

rationale.en: Pungent and warm; traditionally used to warm the middle and move qi and to support the kidney yang; use little with marked internal heat.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味辛、性溫，傳統上用於溫中行氣、助腎陽；內熱明顯者少用。

cautions.en: Not suited to a weak, cold spleen and stomach, or with loose stools.
cautions.zh-Hant: 脾胃虛寒、腹瀉者不宜。

rationale.en: Ophiopogon tea: sweet, bitter and slightly cold; traditionally used to nourish yin and generate fluids, moisten the lung and clear the heart.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、苦、性微寒；傳統功效：養陰生津、潤肺清心。

cautions.en: Not suited during a fever, with a bloated belly or marked internal heat; if you take medicines, ask a doctor or pharmacist first.
cautions.zh-Hant: 感冒發熱、腹脹或內熱明顯時不宜；與藥物併用請先詢問醫師或藥師。

rationale.en: A little astragalus stewed with chicken; astragalus is sweet and slightly warm and traditionally used to tonify qi and raise the yang, to firm the exterior and stop sweating.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、性微溫；傳統功效：補氣昇陽、固表止汗、利水消腫、生津養血、行滯通痺、託毒排膿、斂瘡生肌。

cautions.en: Use with caution in pregnancy, and not in quantity.
cautions.zh-Hant: 孕婦慎用，且不宜多食。

rationale.en: Sweet and neutral; traditionally used to tonify qi and blood and moisten the lung; eat a small amount, well cooked.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、性平，傳統上用於益氣養血、潤肺；少量並煮熟食用。

cautions.en: Use little with loose stools.
cautions.zh-Hant: 大便溏瀉者少用。

rationale.en: Sweet and neutral; traditionally used to nourish the liver and kidney, to benefit essence and blood and to moisten the bowels.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、性平；傳統功效：補肝腎、益精血、潤腸燥。

cautions.en: Not suited in quantity to a weak digestion or a bloated belly.
cautions.zh-Hant: 脾胃虛弱、腹脹者不宜多食。

rationale.en: Sweet and neutral; traditionally used to benefit essence and the eyes, to nourish blood and expel wind, and to promote urination.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、性平；傳統功效：益精明目、養血祛風、利水解毒。

cautions.en: Use little with phlegm-fire or damp stagnation; ask first in pregnancy.
cautions.zh-Hant: 內有痰火、濕滯者少用；孕婦宜先諮詢。

rationale.en: Sweet and warm; traditionally used to tonify the heart and spleen, nourish blood and calm the spirit.
rationale.zh-Hant: 味甘、性溫；傳統功效：補益心脾、養血安神。

general.text: 食飲有節，起居有常，不妄作勞；恬惔虛無，真氣從之，精神內守，病安從來。四季依《四氣調神大論》調養；飲食「穀肉果菜，食養盡之，無使過之，傷其正也」。
general.text_en: Eat and drink in moderation, keep regular hours and do not overwork; keep the mind quiet and free of craving, so that the true qi follows and the spirit is kept within — how then could illness arise? Follow the four seasons in nourishing life, as the chapter on regulating the spirit in accordance with the four seasons describes; for food, "let grains, meat, fruit and vegetables nourish you to the full, without overdoing it, which would harm the right qi".

EX1.en: Keep warm, rest, and avoid wind.

EX2.en: Keep warm, rest and avoid wind; after Guizhi Tang-type formulas the original instructions have you sip hot thin porridge.
EX2.zh-Hant: 保暖、休息、避風；服桂枝湯類後啜熱稀粥（原方服法）

EX3.en: Drink plenty of water and eat light food.

EX4.en: Avoid catching the wind after sweating.

HT1.en: Keep a regular daily rhythm and reduce brooding.

HT2.en: Wind down before bed and avoid stimulation in the evening.
HT2.zh-Hant: 睡前放鬆、避免晚間刺激

HT3.en: Eat less greasy food and have a light evening meal.

KD1.en: Avoid late nights and cut down on spicy, drying food.

KD2.en: Keep the waist and abdomen warm and avoid sitting for long in the cold.
KD2.zh-Hant: 腰腹保暖、避免久坐受寒

LG1.en: Keep warm and out of the wind, and exercise moderately.

LG2.en: Keep the air moist and avoid smoke and dust.

LV1.en: Ease stress, exercise regularly, and find ways to express feelings.
LV1.zh-Hant: 抒壓、規律運動、情緒表達

LV2.en: Cut down on late nights and spicy food, and practise relaxing.
LV2.zh-Hant: 減少熬夜與辛辣、練習放鬆

LV3.en: Sleep enough, avoid late nights, and rest the eyes from long screen time.

LV4.en: Eat when you are calm, and eat small meals more often.
LV4.zh-Hant: 情緒平穩時進食、少量多餐

QB1.en: Keep a regular daily rhythm and avoid overwork.

QB2.en: Stay active regularly and avoid sitting still for long.
QB2.zh-Hant: 規律活動、避免久坐不動

SP1.en: Eat at regular times, chew slowly, and take a walk after meals.
SP1.zh-Hant: 三餐規律、細嚼慢嚥、飯後散步

SP2.en: Avoid raw and cold foods and keep the abdomen warm.

SP4.en: Eat less sweet, greasy and fried food, and exercise regularly to a light sweat.
SP4.zh-Hant: 少甜膩油炸、規律運動出微汗

SP5.en: Avoid tobacco, alcohol and spicy food; eat light food.

SP6.en: Eat less spicy food, and eat small meals more often.
